caption: Each box is one way of pooling machines; each arrow names what the next stage added. The last box keeps metered billing and adds self-service, which turns utility computing into a cloud.

spec.title: From pooled machines to the cloud
spec.aria: A top-to-bottom chain of five stages, mainframe time-sharing, cluster, grid, utility computing and cloud, with labelled arrows naming what each stage added; the final cloud stage is picked out.
